singleSourced.context: At that point, people will be able to pay for cloud gaming time a la carte starting at $0.40 an hour.
Nvidia’s cloud gaming service requires you to already own the games but provides up to 100 hours of “premium monthly playtime” for just $10 a month.
Game Pass Ultimate, which is currently $23 a month, caps out at just 15 hours, but offers instant access to hundreds of games rather than requiring you to already own them on storefronts like Steam.
The smallest amount costs $3.99 for 10 hours, and the largest costs $11.99 for 50 hours.
